note:
The Phase 1 golden suite (PRD section 9). Thirty real small businesses, none of them invented to flatter the template: half are trades, the rest are professional, creative, food, health and education. Each is fed through the onboarding profile exactly as the interview would fill it, so the eval exercises the same path a real user takes.

Every task is checked the same way, so the per-task checks live in `checks` below rather than being repeated thirty times. The suite-level checks in the runner are the ones worth reading: thirty pages that all pass individually but all look identical would be a failure of the template, and only the suite can see that.
